title: Golden Wheel CS-5900
subtitle: High-Speed Double-Needle Double-Chainstitch Flatbed Sewing Machine

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Golden Wheel CS-5900 is a high-speed double-needle double-chainstitch flatbed sewing machine for garment production. Designed for hemming, lap seaming, tape attaching, zipper attaching, decorative stitching, and welting applications.
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (shirts, trousers, blouses, light industrial)

overviewDescription: Made by Golden Wheel / Chee Siang Industrial Co., Ltd. (Taiwan). The CS-5900 is part of Golden Wheel's flat-bed chainstitch lineup, sitting alongside the CS-5910 (single-needle variant). Available with options: P (rear puller), SM (servo motor), MF (electric automatic presser foot lifting). Manufacturer publishes downloadable catalog, instruction manual, and parts book PDFs.
